Cc: onboarding@searchly.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embedding onboarding kickoff and backfill constraints

Hey Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. A few things we want to lock down before the kickoff:
- Which vectorstores you support out of the box and any connector work we'll need (we run a combination of Milvus and an internal AWS ES-backed store).
- Expected downtime or read-only windows for the initial index backfill (we need to keep search live).
- Rerank eval approach — we want to validate top-k quality before cutover.

Attached is a small sample of our current embeddings and a CSV of the doc IDs we plan to migrate. Can you share a recommended staging cutover plan with duration estimates?

Samir
Customer Success / Searchly

Attachments: initial-sample-embeds.csv (csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@searchly.ai>
Cc: onboarding@searchly.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 20:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedding onboarding kickoff and backfill constraints

Hi Samir — great summary, thanks. High-level answers and proposed next steps below.

Quick answers:
- Vectorstore compatibility: Redwood supports direct connectors for Milvus and Faiss; for AWS ES-backed stores we'll use our bulk-export/import adapter (small connector shim). If Searchly wants to keep the ES-backed store read/write during backfill, we can use a shadow-write approach and eventually flip reads to the new index.
- Backfill windows: for a ~100M doc backfill we estimate ~48-72 hours of heavy write activity; with parallel sharding and throttling we can push that to a rolling 7-day migration with near-zero read disruption.
- Rerank eval: recommend a two-stage plan — (1) synthetic smoke tests on a 5k query/ground-truth set, (2) A/B test in staging with live traffic at 5% and manual inspection of top-10 precision/CTR.

Proposed kickoff deliverables (attached workbook has the ops matrix and owner rows):
- Ops_Matrix_v1.xlsx: roles, cutover windows, rollback conditions (owner each row)
- connector-compatibility-checklist.pdf: what needs custom work vs out-of-the-box
- initial-sample-embeds.csv: verify schema and distance metric (you already uploaded)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred migration mode ("rolling" vs "bite-sized waves").
2) Confirm owners for connector work and staging A/B (we can own the connector but will need an API key and a small IAM role).
3) Schedule a 60-min kickoff on Monday to walk through the Ops_Matrix and finalize the 2-week window.

I'll loop internal folks once you confirm mode.

— Jonas
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Ops_Matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet); connector-compatibility-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Embedding onboarding kickoff and backfill constraints — internal ops matrix & owners

Folks — forwarding Samir's note and my reply. Searchly wants minimal read disruption; they run Milvus + an AWS ES-backed store. I attached the Ops_Matrix and compatibility checklist. Please:

- Marissa: lead connector work for the ES-backed store; evaluate whether a write-shim or our bulk adapter is faster. Estimate: 3 dev days + 1 day QA.
- Neha: own rerank evals and the A/B test plan in staging. Draft acceptance criteria (top-10 precision delta, CTR, and manual review buckets).
- Ben: run a cost estimate for both rolling and wave-based backfill (include GPU inference cost + storage ops).
- Rishi: coordinate infra for the 5% staging traffic (canary) and preload KV cache for warmup.

Key constraints to keep in mind (from Samir):
- Search must stay live; preferred migration mode: rolling unless we hear otherwise.
- They can provide a temporary IAM role and a read-replica endpoint for the ES-backed store.

I've proposed a 2-week window starting Sept 20 in the Ops_Matrix but that's flexible. Please reply with owner confirmations and an ETA for your first deliverable by EOD Fri.

Thanks — Jonas

Samir — quick follow-up after internal sync. We consolidated owners and a conservative timeline below.

Confirmed owners and ETA:
- Connector adapter (ES-backed): Marissa Cole — initial adapter prototype by 2027-09-16 (3 dev days + QA), full test harness 2027-09-18.
- Rerank evals and A/B: Neha Kapoor — smoke tests 2027-09-15, staging A/B ready 2027-09-19. Acceptance criteria attached in Ops_Matrix.
- Cost estimate and throttling plan: Ben Carter — draft by 2027-09-14.
- Infra canary + KV preload: Rishi Malhotra — infra ready by 2027-09-18.

Proposed migration approach (final):
1) Week 1 (Sept 20–24) — connector work validation in staging, smoke rerank tests on sample queries (no traffic).
2) Week 2 (Sept 27–Oct 1) — 5% production traffic canary + A/B rerank validation, monitor quality metrics for 48 hours.
3) Cutover (Oct 4–6) — rolling read switch with throttled backfill; daily checkpoints and rollback flag.

We will share a Doc with runbooks and rollback commands in the Drive link and put a DocuSign scope-of-work for the connector work next week. Please let me know if Searchly prefers an earlier window or wants us to switch to bite-sized waves.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

— Jonas
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference
